thig2.4:1.1: aññatarā therībhikkhunī apaññātā. || yāva Kāsijanapado suṅko me tattako ahu | taṃ katvā nigamo agghaṃ agghe 'naggahaṃ ṭhapesi maṃ. || ||
thig2.4:2.1: atha nibbind' ahaṃ rūpe nibbindañ ca virajj' ahaṃ | mā puna jātisaṃsāraṃ sandhāveyyaṃ punappunaṃ | tisso vijjā sacchikatā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || || Aḍḍhakāsī. ||
